doc: FBL 0.12, section 4.9 (segments in any order), FR-024, edge case 17: lenient-trailer.owm of etalii.adp.ide.standalone/src/diagrams/wardley-map/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.WardleyMap.Tests/Fixtures/ at ad1a4680a with two changes, which make it this fixture's: Ordered's line ends in a second label, ' label [4, 4]', and the line 'component Milk [0.3, 0.6]' follows it.
